toys.label: Yarn ball
lines: {name} pounces on the yarn ball and rolls over with it, tail wagging!
{name} bats the yarn ball across the floor and chases it.
{name} gets tangled in the yarn and looks very proud of itself.
toys.tiredLine: {name} is catching its breath. Let it rest a moment before the next game.

toys.label: Pinecone
lines: {name} carries the pinecone around like a treasure.
{name} tosses the pinecone up and catches it on its nose!
{name} hides the pinecone in the nest, then 'finds' it again.
toys.tiredLine: {name} is catching its breath. Let it rest a moment before the next game.

tricks.label: Spin
tricks.learned: New trick! Aunt June shows you how to wave your finger in a circle, and {name} chases its tail in a happy spin.
tricks.line: {name} spins around three times and wobbles to a stop.

tricks.label: Roll over
tricks.learned: New trick! Kit taught {name} to roll over, and named it the Pancake Roll.
tricks.line: The Pancake Roll! {name} flops over and shows its belly.

tricks.label: Smoke ring
tricks.learned: New trick! After fire control, {name} can puff a perfect smoke ring (just smoke, no flame).
tricks.line: {name} puffs a perfect little smoke ring. Ta-da!

tricks.label: Loop-the-loop
tricks.learned: New trick! After all that flight practice, {name} can do a loop-the-loop.
tricks.line: {name} flaps up, does a loop-the-loop, and lands with a bow.

twists.text: Where's {name}? The nest is empty... then a tail pokes out from under the bed. It was playing hide-and-seek!
{name} brought you a present this morning: a very shiny bottle cap. It's the best thing it owns.
The treehouse is so exciting that {name} does three laps of it before breakfast. Zoomies!
A butterfly lands on {name}'s nose. It goes cross-eyed trying to look at it, then sneezes a tiny sparkle.
{name} has learned to say good morning: a warm little huff right on your cheek.
BLINK beeps at the window, and {name} tries to play tag with it through the glass.
{name} found a feather from somewhere far away and won't stop looking at it.
{name} is waiting for you at the treehouse door, wings wiggling. It knows today is special.
